name: chon-work-buddy
description: 公考备考 Web 工作台（React + Express 全栈，数据跨浏览器同步）

scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.server: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server start
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "PORT=8788 npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
